subject: PrecisionAI outage — proposed goodwill credit and trial extension
messages:
From: Sabrina Cole <sabrina.cole@precisionai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: PrecisionAI Billing <billing@precisionai.com>
Date: 2028-03-13T21:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production interruption during nightly import window

Hi Jordan,

We saw a service interruption on 2028-03-13 between 02:10 and 02:34 UTC while our nightly import jobs were running. Calls to the Redwood API returned 504s and several long tail 5xx spikes for about 22 minutes. This caused our downstream processing to fail and delayed deliveries to a number of customers.

I've attached a short incident log from our side (precisionai-incident-log-20280313.txt) and a snippet of failed requests. Our billing team is copied here because we'll need a remediation path and, realistically, a token/credit make-good while we validate data integrity.

Ticket: SUPPORT-9872
Impact: production pipelines retried, delayed downstream by ~90 minutes overall

We'd like to request a goodwill credit to help offset the operational impact and a short extension of our trial window while we complete validation. Please let me know what information you need.

Thanks,
Sabrina Cole
Head of Platform, PrecisionAI
Sabrina.Cole@precisionai.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Cole <sabrina.cole@precisionai.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-13T22:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption during nightly import window

Hi Sabrina — I'm really sorry to hear this. Thank you for the log and the ticket ID — that's helpful.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
- I'll coordinate internal approval for a goodwill credit and a 30-day trial extension.
- Hannah (CS) will work with you on the validation plan for reprocessing any affected batches.
- Karthik, can you help with an estimate for a token credit that feels proportional to the impact here?

Proposed starting point: a token top-up equivalent to $10k plus a 30-day extension while we verify the pipeline results. If that's not viable internally, we'll present alternatives (smaller credit + longer trial stretch).

I'll loop in billing today and aim to get a concrete response within 24 business hours. Appreciate the patience — we'll make this right.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-14T08:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: PrecisionAI outage — goodwill credit request (SUPPORT-9872)

Team — forwarding PrecisionAI's note. They experienced a ~22-minute regression that caused retries and downstream delays. Highlights and ask below.

PrecisionAI (Sabrina) asked for: token/credit make-good + short trial extension while they validate. Attached: precisionai-incident-log-20280313.txt (they provided).

My proposal to expedite: offer a two-part remediation: a one-time token credit and a 30-day trial extension. Suggested starting ask from me: $10,000 token equivalent + 30 days. They'll need the credit posted to their account and written confirmation for their procurement team.

Questions for billing/ops:
- Monica: is $10k reasonable given our precedents for ~20–30 minute incidents involving retry storms?
- Karthik: if we set a credit in HubSpot as token_credit_20280314, what are the mechanics (ledger entry vs promo code)?
- Hannah: CS will confirm reprocessing schedule with PrecisionAI; if they need replays from our side, we'll coordinate.

I'm hoping we can finalize by EOD today so we can send a clean, prescriptive note to Sabrina with next steps and a DocuSign link if they need a quick acceptance note for procurement.

Thanks,
Jordan

Date: 2028-03-14T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: PrecisionAI outage — goodwill credit request (SUPPORT-9872)

Jordan — thanks for the clear framing. We reviewed the incident snapshot and precedent cases from Q1. Recommended remedy: a one-time account credit equivalent to $9,000 applied against next invoice + a 30-day trial extension (adds 30 days to their current trial expiry). Rationale: this balances a proportional remedy with our credit policy for transient latency/504 events under 30 minutes.

Operational notes:
- I'll create a billing adjustment entry (ledger ID: ADJ-20280314-913) and notify finance.
- We can post a promo token instead if PrecisionAI prefers a token code for platform usage; let us know and we'll issue token_credit_20280314.
- For procurement: we'll share a short acceptance memo via DocuSign (link below) to confirm PrecisionAI accepts the credit and the trial extension terms.

Attachments: credit-approval-note-20280314.pdf (internal approval memo)

If everyone is aligned, Jordan please send Sabrina a confirmation note with the DocuSign link and the expected timing for the credit.

Monica Patel
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sabrina Cole <sabrina.cole@precisionai.com>
Cc: PrecisionAI Billing <billing@precisionai.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production interruption during nightly import window — remediation confirmed

Hi Sabrina — thanks again for raising this and for your patience while we reviewed the data.

Summary of what we've approved and next steps: 
- One-time goodwill credit: $9,000 applied to PrecisionAI's next invoice (ledger ADJ-20280314-913).
- Trial extension: 30 days added; new trial expiry: 2028-04-14.
- Optional token: if you'd rather receive a usage token instead of a billing credit, we can issue token_credit_20280314 (let me know and Monica will post it).

Action items for PrecisionAI:
1) Please sign the brief acceptance memo so finance/procurement has a record of the agreement: https://docusign.net/sign/0A1B2C
2) Hannah will follow up within 24 hours on the replay/validation plan for any affected batches.
3) We'll mark SUPPORT-9872 resolved once you confirm validation results.

Attachments: support-SUPPORT-9872-snapshot.png, credit-approval-note-20280314.pdf

We appreciate your partnership; we'll keep monitoring and will circle back if we see any further anomalies.

Best,
